# FG-INT-0014

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`gitlab-mirror`](../../ops/runbooks/gitlab-mirror.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_mirror_behind_the_threshold_is_int_0014` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: GitLab へのミラーが遅れています。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The mirror to GitLab is behind. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Mirror ke GitLab tertinggal. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

A push mirror has had a push waiting longer than `mirror.lag_alert_secs` (default 900 s): `forge.push_mirror_status.pending_since` (the first push not yet mirrored) is older than the threshold. Found by the worker's mirror sweep (every minute; logged once per mirror per hour while it lasts) and by `forge doctor` (`mirror.lag`). Usual causes: the job keeps failing (see FG-INT-0013 for the same repo_id), the worker is down or its mirror lane is off (`forge.worker.mirror_lane_off`: `mirror.credentials_dir` unset), or the job queue is backed up. The insurance copy on GitLab is stale (plan 06 §4.11: "保険が実は古かった").

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Filter logs by error_code=FG-INT-0014: `repo_id`, `project_id`, `pending_since`, `lag_secs`, `last_success_at`, `last_error_code`. Check `forge doctor` (`mirror.lag`, `mirror.status`, `jobs`), the worker's start-up log (`forge.worker.mirror_lane_off`) and SELECT state, attempts, last_error_code FROM forge.jobs WHERE kind = 'repository.push_mirror' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook gitlab-mirror: start the worker or enable its mirror lane, fix the failure behind FG-INT-0013 if any, then `gstn mirror sync --project <id>`; the alert stops when a push succeeds (pending_since returns to NULL).
